Coffee___Cercospora_Leaf_Spot.diseaseName: Cercospora leaf spot / brown eye spot (Cercospora coffeicola)
symptoms: Small round brown spots with a pale grey or white centre and a yellow halo, like an eye
Dark, sunken, dry patches on berries, which may ripen early
Leaves drop early when many spots are present
Coffee___Cercospora_Leaf_Spot.treatment: Improve plant nutrition, especially nitrogen, and reduce water stress. Copper-based fungicides help protect new growth. Ask your agrovet or extension officer for the product and rate registered in Kenya.
prevention: Balanced fertiliser and mulching
Moderate shade where suitable
Remove and destroy heavily spotted leaves and berries

symptoms: No visible signs of disease or pest damage
Coffee___Healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Keep monitoring, especially during the rains.
prevention: Check leaves weekly for rust, spots and mines
Prune for good air flow
Keep nutrition balanced

symptoms: Irregular brown dried blotches (mines) on the upper leaf surface
The dried skin of the mine peels off, with small larvae inside
Heavy attack causes leaves to fall
possibleCauses: pest damage: moth larvae feeding inside the leaf
natural enemies killed by broad-spectrum sprays
Coffee___Leaf_Miner.treatment: Count active mines before spraying; many attacks are controlled by natural parasites. If damage is heavy, use an insecticide recommended by your extension officer and avoid broad-spectrum products. Ask your agrovet for the product and rate registered in Kenya.
prevention: Protect natural enemies by avoiding unnecessary sprays
Keep some shade and ground cover
Monitor regularly in dry spells

symptoms: Dark brown to black patches, often at leaf tips and edges
Young leaves and shoot tips turn black and die back
Worse after cold, wet and windy weather
possibleCauses: cold wet weather at high altitude
Coffee___Phoma.treatment: Prune out and destroy dead shoot tips. Copper-based fungicides protect new growth during cold wet periods. Ask your agrovet or extension officer for the product and rate registered in Kenya.
prevention: Plant windbreaks on exposed slopes
Protect new flushes during cold wet seasons
Keep trees well nourished

symptoms: Small pale yellow spots on young leaves at first
Yellow to orange powdery patches on the underside of leaves, with pale yellow patches on the upper side
Leaves fall early; heavy attack can strip the tree and cause branch dieback
possibleCauses: fungal infection spread by wind and rain splash
Coffee___Rust.treatment: Spray at the right time: in the main coffee areas of Kenya, rust sprays start in mid-October before the short rains, with a second spray three weeks later. Use only fungicides on the Pest Control Products Board list for coffee, and alternate between product groups so the rust does not become resistant. Ask your agrovet or cooperative for a registered product and follow the label.
prevention: Plant resistant varieties: Ruiru 11 is highly resistant to rust and Batian is moderately resistant
Prune coffee trees regularly so air moves between the branches

source.title: Coffee Leaf Rust (Hemileia vastatrix) in Kenya: A Review (Coffee Research Institute, KALRO; Agronomy 2021)

sw.diseaseName: Kutu ya majani ya kahawa (Hemileia vastatrix)
symptoms: Mwanzoni madoa madogo ya manjano hafifu kwenye majani machanga
Mabaka ya unga wa manjano hadi rangi ya chungwa chini ya majani, na mabaka ya manjano hafifu upande wa juu
Majani huanguka mapema; shambulio kubwa linaweza kuacha mti bila majani na kukausha matawi
sw.treatment: Nyunyizia kwa wakati unaofaa: katika maeneo makuu ya kahawa nchini Kenya, unyunyiziaji wa kutu huanza katikati ya Oktoba kabla ya mvua fupi, na unyunyiziaji wa pili wiki tatu baadaye. Tumia tu dawa za kuvu zilizo kwenye orodha ya Bodi ya Kudhibiti Bidhaa za Wadudu (PCPB) kwa kahawa, na ubadilishe makundi ya dawa ili kutu isizoee dawa. Muulize muuzaji wa pembejeo za kilimo au chama chako cha ushirika dawa iliyosajiliwa na ufuate maelekezo ya lebo.
prevention: Panda aina zinazostahimili kutu: Ruiru 11 inastahimili sana na Batian inastahimili kiasi
Pogoa miti ya kahawa mara kwa mara ili hewa ipite kati ya matawi

short.name: kutu ya majani
short.action: Nyunyizia katikati ya Oktoba kabla ya mvua fupi, na tena wiki tatu baadaye. Muulize muuzaji wa pembejeo au chama chako dawa ya kutu iliyosajiliwa.

short.name: leaf rust
short.action: Spray in mid-October before the short rains, and again three weeks later. Ask your agrovet or cooperative for a registered rust spray.

symptoms: Small dark water-soaked spots on leaves, often with a yellow halo
Spots join up and leaves turn yellow and dry
Small raised scabby spots on green fruit
Tomato___Bacterial_Spot.treatment: There is no cure. Remove badly infected plants. Copper-based bactericides can slow the spread. Ask your agrovet or extension officer for the product and rate registered in Kenya.
prevention: Use certified disease-free seed and seedlings
Rotate away from tomato, pepper and potato
Avoid overhead watering and do not work among wet plants

symptoms: Small dark spots that start on older leaves near the ground
Round brown spots with rings inside like a target; the leaf around them often turns yellow
Badly infected leaves turn brown and fall off
Dark sunken patches on stems, and black leathery spots with rings near the fruit stalk
possibleCauses: warm weather with rain or heavy dew
Tomato___Early_Blight.treatment: Remove leaves with spots as soon as you see them and bury or burn them, but do not take off more than one third of the plant's leaves. Wash your hands and tools after touching infected plants, and keep leaves dry. If you need a fungicide, spray when the weather favours the disease and change between product groups. Ask your agrovet for a product registered in Kenya and follow the label.
prevention: Grow resistant varieties
Cover the soil under plants with mulch so soil does not splash onto the leaves
Water at the base of the plant, not over the leaves
Stake plants, remove weeds and space plants so air moves between them
Wait at least two years before planting tomato or related crops in the same place
Use seed from healthy plants only

source.title: Early blight in tomato and potato (University of Minnesota Extension)

symptoms: Madoa madogo meusi yanayoanzia kwenye majani ya zamani karibu na ardhi
Madoa ya duara ya kahawia yenye pete ndani kama shabaha; jani linalozunguka mara nyingi hugeuka manjano
Majani yaliyoathirika sana hugeuka kahawia na kuanguka
Mabaka meusi yaliyobonyea kwenye mashina, na madoa meusi magumu yenye pete karibu na kikonyo cha tunda
sw.treatment: Ondoa majani yenye madoa mara unapoyaona na uyazike au uyachome, lakini usiondoe zaidi ya theluthi moja ya majani ya mmea. Osha mikono na vifaa baada ya kugusa mimea iliyoambukizwa, na weka majani makavu. Ikiwa unahitaji dawa ya kuvu, nyunyizia wakati hali ya hewa inapendelea ugonjwa na ubadilishe makundi ya dawa. Muulize muuzaji wa pembejeo za kilimo dawa iliyosajiliwa Kenya na ufuate maelekezo ya lebo.
prevention: Panda aina zinazostahimili ugonjwa
Funika udongo chini ya mimea kwa matandazo ili udongo usirukie majani
Mwagilia chini ya mmea, si juu ya majani
Weka miti ya kushikilia mimea, ondoa magugu na uache nafasi ili hewa ipite
Subiri angalau miaka miwili kabla ya kupanda nyanya au mazao jamii yake mahali pale pale
Tumia mbegu kutoka kwa mimea yenye afya pekee

short.name: baa la mapema
short.action: Chuma majani yenye madoa na uyazike au uyachome. Weka majani makavu. Ugonjwa ukiendelea kuenea, muulize muuzaji wa pembejeo dawa iliyosajiliwa Kenya.

short.name: early blight
short.action: Pick off leaves with spots and bury or burn them. Keep leaves dry. If it keeps spreading, ask your agrovet for a spray registered in Kenya.

symptoms: No visible signs of disease or pest damage
Tomato___Healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Keep monitoring, especially in wet weather.
prevention: Check leaves twice a week in the rains
Remove weeds that host pests
Water at the base, not over the leaves

symptoms: Large dark brown patches on leaves with a grey-green edge, not stopped by the leaf veins
Thin white powdery growth on leaves, stems and fruit when the air is humid
Firm dark brown patches on stems and firm brown spots on fruit
In cool wet weather whole plants turn brown and wilt quickly
possibleCauses: infected seedlings or nearby infected tomato or potato crops
Tomato___Late_Blight.treatment: Check plants often, especially in cool wet weather, and act early. If only a few plants are infected, pull them out and destroy them so the disease does not spread through the field. Fungicide sprays work best when applied before infection, while the weather favours the disease. Late blight needs a product made for water moulds, and the same product group should not be used again and again. Ask your agrovet for a product registered in Kenya and follow the label.
prevention: Plant where no tomato, potato, pepper or eggplant has grown for the past three to four years
Check seedlings for late blight before you buy or plant them
Keep leaves dry: water at the base of the plant, in the morning
Stake plants and space them so air moves between them
Remove volunteer potato plants and destroy crop remains at the end of the season

source.title: Late blight of tomato and potato (University of Minnesota Extension)

symptoms: Mabaka makubwa ya kahawia iliyokolea kwenye majani yenye ukingo wa kijani-kijivu, yasiyozuiwa na mishipa ya jani
Ukungu mwembamba mweupe kama unga kwenye majani, mashina na matunda hewa ikiwa na unyevu
Mabaka magumu ya kahawia iliyokolea kwenye mashina na madoa magumu ya kahawia kwenye matunda
Katika hali ya baridi na mvua mimea yote hubadilika kahawia na kunyauka haraka
sw.treatment: Kagua mimea mara kwa mara, hasa wakati wa baridi na mvua, na uchukue hatua mapema. Ikiwa mimea michache tu imeambukizwa, ing'oe na uiharibu ili ugonjwa usienee shambani. Dawa za kuvu hufanya kazi vizuri zaidi zikinyunyiziwa kabla ya maambukizi, wakati hali ya hewa inapendelea ugonjwa. Baa chelewa inahitaji dawa iliyotengenezwa kwa ajili ya ukungu wa maji, na kundi moja la dawa lisitumike tena na tena. Muulize muuzaji wa pembejeo za kilimo dawa iliyosajiliwa Kenya na ufuate maelekezo ya lebo.
prevention: Panda mahali ambapo nyanya, viazi, pilipili au biringanya hazijapandwa kwa miaka mitatu hadi minne iliyopita
Kagua miche kuona baa chelewa kabla ya kununua au kupanda
Weka majani makavu: mwagilia chini ya mmea, asubuhi
Weka miti ya kushikilia mimea na uiache nafasi ili hewa ipite kati yake
Ondoa viazi vinavyoota vyenyewe na uharibu mabaki ya mazao mwishoni mwa msimu

short.name: baa chelewa
short.action: Ng'oa mimea iliyougua na uiharibu ili ugonjwa usienee. Weka majani makavu, na umuulize muuzaji wa pembejeo dawa ya baa iliyosajiliwa Kenya.

short.name: late blight
short.action: Pull out sick plants and destroy them so it does not spread. Keep leaves dry, and ask your agrovet for a blight spray registered in Kenya.

symptoms: Pale green or yellow patches on the upper leaf surface
Olive-green to brown velvety mould under the leaves
Mostly in greenhouses and very humid conditions
possibleCauses: high humidity and poor air flow
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.treatment: Lower humidity by opening vents and spacing plants. Remove infected leaves. Fungicides may be needed if it spreads. Ask your agrovet or extension officer for the product and rate registered in Kenya.
prevention: Ventilate greenhouses well
Prune lower leaves for air flow
Choose resistant varieties

symptoms: Light and dark green patchy mottling on leaves
Leaves twisted, narrow or fern-like
Stunted plants with fewer, uneven fruit
possibleCauses: virus spread by hands, tools and infected seed
Tomato___Mosaic_Virus.treatment: There is no cure. Uproot and destroy infected plants early. Wash hands and disinfect tools before handling healthy plants.
prevention: Use certified seed and resistant varieties
Do not smoke or handle tobacco near the crop
Disinfect tools and stakes between seasons

symptoms: Small round grey spots with dark borders, starting on the lower leaves
Tiny black dots inside the spots
Spots grow and join up; leaves turn yellow and die
Usually appears when the first fruit begins to form
Tomato___Septoria_Leaf_Spot.treatment: Remove infected leaves during the season and remove all infected plant parts at the end of the season. Where the disease is severe every year, a fungicide applied early, when symptoms first appear, slows its spread. Ask your agrovet for a product registered in Kenya and follow the label.
prevention: Space plants well and remove suckers from the base of the plant for air flow
Check seedlings carefully for spots before planting
Mulch well so soil does not splash onto the leaves
Water at the base of the plant and keep the leaves dry
Prune off the lowest leaf branches once plants are established and starting to fruit

sw.diseaseName: Madoa ya majani ya Septoria (Septoria lycopersici)
symptoms: Madoa madogo ya duara ya kijivu yenye ukingo mweusi, yanayoanzia kwenye majani ya chini
Vitone vidogo vyeusi ndani ya madoa
Madoa hukua na kuungana; majani hugeuka manjano na kufa
Kwa kawaida huonekana matunda ya kwanza yanapoanza kutokea

Muulize muuzaji wa pembejeo za kilimo dawa iliyosajiliwa Kenya na ufuate maelekezo ya lebo.
prevention: Acha nafasi ya kutosha kati ya mimea na uondoe machipukizi ya chini ili hewa ipite
Kagua miche kwa makini kuona madoa kabla ya kupanda
Weka matandazo ya kutosha ili udongo usirukie majani
Mwagilia chini ya mmea na uweke majani makavu
Pogoa matawi ya majani ya chini kabisa mimea ikishaimarika na kuanza kuzaa

short.name: madoa ya majani ya Septoria
short.action: Chuma majani yenye madoa na uweke majani makavu. Ikiwa ni mbaya kila mwaka, muulize muuzaji wa pembejeo dawa iliyosajiliwa Kenya na uitumie mapema.

short.name: Septoria leaf spot
short.action: Pick off leaves with spots and keep leaves dry. If it is bad every year, ask your agrovet for a spray registered in Kenya and use it early.

symptoms: Brown spots with rings and a yellow halo, easily confused with early blight
Spots can merge and dry large parts of the leaf
Small sunken brown spots on fruit
Tomato___Target_Spot.treatment: Remove infected leaves and improve air flow. Fungicides may be needed. Ask your agrovet or extension officer for the product and rate registered in Kenya.

Rotate crops
Remove crop debris after harvest

symptoms: Leaves curl upward and cup, with yellow edges
Young leaves small and crumpled
Stunted plants; flowers drop and few fruit form
Tomato___Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.treatment: There is no cure. Uproot infected plants early. Control whiteflies with yellow sticky traps and an insecticide recommended by your extension officer. Ask your agrovet for the product and rate registered in Kenya.
prevention: Raise seedlings under insect-proof net
Use tolerant varieties
Remove weeds that host whiteflies

symptoms: Sunken round spots on fruit with rings of orange or pink spores
Small irregular brown spots on leaves
Fruit rots, especially when ripening
Pepper___Anthracnose.treatment: Pick and destroy infected fruit. Fungicides can protect healthy fruit. Ask your agrovet or extension officer for the product and rate registered in Kenya.
prevention: Use clean seed
Rotate crops and remove debris
Harvest promptly and avoid wounding fruit

symptoms: Small water-soaked spots on leaves that turn brown
Leaves yellow and drop
Raised scabby spots on fruit
Pepper___Bacterial_Spot.treatment: There is no cure. Remove infected plants. Copper-based bactericides can slow the spread. Ask your agrovet or extension officer for the product and rate registered in Kenya.
prevention: Use certified seed and seedlings
Rotate away from pepper and tomato
Avoid overhead watering

symptoms: No visible signs of disease or pest damage
prevention: Check for aphids and whiteflies
Water at the base
Remove weeds around the crop

symptoms: Patchy light and dark green mottling
Leaves narrow, distorted or wrinkled
Stunted plants and misshapen fruit
possibleCauses: virus spread by hands and tools
Pepper___Mosaic_Virus.treatment: There is no cure. Remove and destroy infected plants. Control aphids with a method recommended by your extension officer.
prevention: Use tolerant varieties and clean seedlings
Control aphids early
Remove weeds that host the virus

symptoms: Angular brown spots boxed in by leaf veins
Grey fuzzy growth under the spots in humid weather
Reddish-brown spots on pods
Bean___Angular_Leaf_Spot.treatment: Remove badly infected plants. Fungicides may help in wet seasons. Ask your agrovet or extension officer for the product and rate registered in Kenya.
prevention: Plant certified clean seed
Rotate with non-legume crops
Use tolerant varieties

symptoms: Dark red to black streaks along the veins under the leaves
Sunken dark spots on pods with pink or tan centres
Spotted, discoloured seed
Bean___Anthracnose.treatment: Remove infected plants. Fungicides can protect the crop in wet weather. Ask your agrovet or extension officer for the product and rate registered in Kenya.
prevention: Plant certified clean seed, never seed from infected pods
Do not work in the field when plants are wet
Rotate crops

symptoms: No visible signs of disease or pest damage
prevention: Check leaves weekly
Rotate crops each season
Use certified seed

symptoms: Small reddish-brown powdery spots, mostly under the leaves
Yellow rings around the spots
Leaves dry and fall early

Remove crop debris after harvest
Avoid planting next to an infected crop

symptoms: Small dark spots that start on older leaves near the ground
Round brown spots with rings inside like a target; the leaf around them often turns yellow

possibleCauses: warm weather with rain or heavy dew
infected crop debris in the soil
Potato___Early_Blight.treatment: Remove infected leaves carefully and take them far from the field, and clean your tools afterwards. Keep leaves dry and avoid working among wet plants. If you need a fungicide, spray when the weather favours the disease and change between product groups. Ask your agrovet for a product registered in Kenya and follow the label.
prevention: Rotate out of potato, tomato and related crops for at least two years
Control nightshade weeds and volunteer plants
Fertilise well to keep plants growing strongly
Avoid overhead watering so the leaves stay dry
Remove or bury infected plants after harvest

sw.diseaseName: Baa la mapema la viazi (Alternaria solani)
symptoms: Madoa madogo meusi yanayoanzia kwenye majani ya zamani karibu na ardhi
Madoa ya duara ya kahawia yenye pete ndani kama shabaha; jani linalozunguka mara nyingi hugeuka manjano
Majani yaliyoathirika sana hugeuka kahawia na kuanguka, au hukauka na kuning'inia kwenye shina
sw.treatment: Ondoa majani yaliyoambukizwa kwa uangalifu na uyapeleke mbali na shamba, kisha safisha vifaa vyako. Weka majani makavu na usifanye kazi kati ya mimea iliyolowa. Ikiwa unahitaji dawa ya kuvu, nyunyizia wakati hali ya hewa inapendelea ugonjwa na ubadilishe makundi ya dawa. Muulize muuzaji wa pembejeo za kilimo dawa iliyosajiliwa Kenya na ufuate maelekezo ya lebo.
prevention: Badilisha mazao: usipande viazi, nyanya au mazao jamii yake kwa angalau miaka miwili
Dhibiti magugu jamii ya mnavu na mimea inayoota yenyewe
Weka mbolea ipasavyo ili mimea ikue kwa nguvu
Epuka kumwagilia juu ya majani ili yabaki makavu
Ondoa au zika mimea iliyoambukizwa baada ya kuvuna

short.name: baa la mapema
short.action: Ondoa majani yaliyougua na uyapeleke mbali na shamba. Weka majani makavu. Ugonjwa ukiendelea kuenea, muulize muuzaji wa pembejeo dawa iliyosajiliwa Kenya.

short.name: early blight
short.action: Remove sick leaves and take them away from the field. Keep leaves dry. If it keeps spreading, ask your agrovet for a spray registered in Kenya.

symptoms: No visible signs of disease or pest damage
Potato___Healthy.treatment: No treatment needed. Keep monitoring, especially for late blight in wet weather.
prevention: Check leaves twice a week in the rains
Hill up soil around stems
Use certified seed potatoes

symptoms: Leaves, stems and tubers turn brown or black and rot
Unlike early blight, the brown spots have no rings inside
Infected tubers rot, also in storage
Potato___Late_Blight.treatment: Inspect your crop often and act as soon as you see late blight. Spray a fungicide registered in Kenya for potato late blight as soon as the disease appears. Repeat every two weeks in wet weather and every three weeks in dry weather, until two weeks before harvest, and spray when the leaves are dry. Ask your agrovet for the product and follow the label.
prevention: Use clean seed potatoes from a source you trust
Plant a different crop in the field the following year
Earth up soil along the rows to protect the tubers
Remove and destroy all stems and leaves at least two weeks before harvest
Grow varieties with some resistance, such as Tigoni

source.title: Potato late blight, Plantwise factsheet for farmers KE019En (CABI, created in Kenya)

symptoms: Majani, mashina na viazi hubadilika kahawia au weusi na kuoza

Pandisha udongo kando ya mistari ili kulinda viazi
Ondoa na uharibu mashina na majani yote angalau wiki mbili kabla ya kuvuna
Panda aina zenye ustahimilivu kiasi, kama Tigoni

short.name: baa chelewa

short.name: late blight
short.action: Spray as soon as you see it, using a blight spray registered in Kenya from your agrovet. Repeat every two weeks in wet weather.

symptoms: No visible signs of disease or pest damage
